controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 npm run check:mutation-specs 印每個 spec 檔的探針數,exit 1 = DRIFT(內容層、改 spec 或碼)/ exit 2 = 無法判定(spec 目錄或檔案不可信、0 個 spec 檔、walker I/O 失敗、collision 命中、或 formatReport 結果集為空 defense-in-depth 第二道);hardlink spec / target 對本 CI(純讀 caller)= 放行,exit 依樣本判定(P2#3 defer ⑥);對破壞性 mutate CLI(Step 4.5 人工跑)= exit 2(nlink=1 拒)
controls.degradation: spec 目錄非真目錄 / 0 個 spec 檔 / spec 檔本身 symlink、未追蹤、非一般檔、非 UTF-8 / walker 遇 symlink 子目錄 / walker lstat / readdir / stat I/O 失敗或型別無法判定 / 同名衝突(大小寫差異) / formatReport 結果集為空(defense-in-depth 第二道,P2#3 defer ⑩) / root 解析失敗(fs.realpathSync throw)/ argv 錯(parseRootArg fail-closed) → exit 2(無法判定,不放行);未預期例外:main try/catch 印訊息但不重設 exit code(保留當前 code:runCheck 前拋 = initial 2、runCheck 回傳並賦值後拋 = 該次 report code(0/1/2));hardlink 對純讀 CI(readCheckedTarget)= 不拒判、樣本仍要對得上;對破壞性 mutate CLI(checkTarget + writeCheckedSync 內的 nlink !== 1 拒判為雙層 nlink guard 第二道)= exit 2 拒判(避免改到 repo 外 alias)
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: 只驗「樣本對得上」,不證明探針仍會 kill;完整 mutation 仍由 Step 4.5 人工跑並綁 HEAD。是 mutate.ts 閘② 的 CI 前置版。discovery 契約 D1-D7 見 check-mutation-specs.ts 檔頭 docstring(P2#3 defer ⑤ 拍板 + defer ⑥ 補述;D6 呼叫端邊界含 checkTarget / readCheckedTarget,checkTarget 公開 signature 與 nlink=1 observable behavior 不動、內部允許 helper/refactor 抽出)。P2#3 defer ⑥:純讀 caller 分流出 readCheckedTarget、放寬 nlink=1;mutate main CLI 迴圈的第一次 checkTarget 呼叫仍走此路徑;writeCheckedSync 內的 nlink !== 1 拒判為第二道防線不動;ReadTargetCheck 為 discriminated union、刻意不含 dev/ino/mode/abs,由 TS 型別編譯期擋純讀 API 誤接破壞性寫回(mutation-spec-drift.json MSD-M8 直接 killer + tests/mutate.test.ts @ts-expect-error 編譯期證據)。P2#3 defer ⑪:--root 假設 real git worktree top-level;nested outer-tracked 子目錄不支援(信任邊界依賴外層 repo git index、非 --root 認可 boundary);詳見 check-mutation-specs.ts 檔頭 docstring + scripts/mutations/README.md「discovery 契約」+「CI 守樣本漂移」段

controls.name: GitHub branch protection
controls.locator: Trusted schedule-only workflow branch-protection.yml + CLI check-branch-protection.ts;gh api /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection 對每支 protectedBranches 驗 A-D 契約(required_status_checks / contexts 非空 / enforce_admins.enabled=true / required_pull_request_reviews);trust boundary:schedule-only + ref: main trusted checkout + BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN secret 完全不 leak 至 PR CI

controls.bypass: admin override(組織治理層、非 CI-controlled)
controls.notes: Sprint 19 C1 升 record-only → schedule-based governance:trusted workflow + fine-grained PAT secret(BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN、Repository Administration: read + Contents: read)、每日 UTC 00:00 抓 protected-branch drift;adopter setup runbook 見 docs/ADOPTION.md §2.6。**failureBehavior:block 語意**:scheduled run 內部 fail-closed(exit 2),該 workflow run 標紅、Owner 於 Actions tab 稽核;此**不是** per-PR merge gate。⚠️ **不能透過把此 schedule-only workflow 加進 branch protection required status checks 來成 per-PR gate**——workflow 只在 schedule 觸發且 checkout ref=main,不在 PR head SHA 上執行;加進 required checks 只會讓 PR 缺對應 check、卡 pending,並未驗證該 PR 本身。若要每 PR 重驗 A-D 契約,需另行設計 PR-head verifier(token / trust boundary 另議),為本次 optimization out-of-scope、本 harness 尚未提供,不擴 workflow / secret / policy。PR 立即反饋為承 trust boundary trade-off、由 daily schedule 抓 drift

controls.notes: GOV-005 branch-protection advisory 仍保留;本 control 是機器化 drift gate、獨立於 GOV-005 身分。--base 必用 immutable PR base SHA(github.event.pull_request.base.sha),非 branch ref;checkout 前置需 fetch-depth: 0 或明確 fetch base SHA object

controls.name: Mutation Kill Smoke Check
controls.locator: CI step「Mutation Kill Smoke Check」;對 pinned 6 條 smoke probe(runner 內硬編碼 SMOKE_PROBES map:每 spec index 0 + expectedEntryFingerprint SHA-256 of canonical JSON of {file, find, replace, label} + hardcoded testSuite paths)、CI 自動 apply mutation via mutate.ts CLI + 跑 pinned test file + assert mutant killed。7 步 algorithm:read+validate manifest schema($schema pin + cardinality/duplicate/set-equality)→ clean tree + startHEAD → verify entry fingerprints → pre-control unique testSuite green → per-probe spawn mutate.ts argv-safe(shell:false + detached process group + SIGTERM 60s + SIGKILL 5s grace)→ post-control 再跑 unique testSuite → verify tree + HEAD 不變
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;runner stderr per-probe summary(probeId + exit code + duration);本機 npm run mutation:smoke
controls.degradation: manifest schema violation(cardinality / duplicate / set-equality / unknown probeId / bad regex)→ exit 2;fingerprint mismatch(spec[index] entry 任一欄位改變)→ exit 2;pre-control 或 post-control 紅 → exit 2;mutate.ts indeterminate 或 timeout → exit 2;tree dirty 或 HEAD 改變 → exit 2
controls.bypass: admin override(組織治理層);PR 可移 CI step / 改 package script / 改 runner SMOKE_PROBES / 改 manifest / 改 target test(protected-path human review 責任)
controls.notes: ⚠️ 誠實邊界(三處 SSOT 對齊 docs/ADOPTION.md §5.2 + CI step comment):本 gate 是 accidental-regression signal、非 malicious-PR security boundary。CI wiring(runner / manifest / test / workflow / package.json)都 PR-controllable、machine gate 不對抗 PR wiring 修改。⚠️ 舊 wording「唯一防線 = required-check(GOV-005 branch protection + CI-015 machine check)」實務上不成立:GOV-005 / CI-015 皆 schedule-only workflow、不在 PR head 執行、不能作 branch protection required status check;真 per-PR malicious-PR 防線需另設 PR-head verifier(本次 optimization out-of-scope、本 harness 尚未提供)。**durable evidence boundary(Step 4 Codex
